<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Nimbus — morphing landing page</title><style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--accent:124,92,255;--accent2:45,212,191;--muted:#a0a0b4;--panel:rgba(255,255,255,.055);--panel2:rgba(255,255,255,.1);--border:rgba(255,255,255,.12);--card:rgba(17,17,26,.55);--navbg:rgba(12,12,16,.55);--vign:rgba(0,0,0,.35);--shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.38);--hudbg:rgba(16,16,24,.7);--hudfg:#cfcfda;--hudbd:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
:root[data-theme=light]{color-scheme:light;--muted:#5f5f6e;--panel:rgba(20,20,35,.05);--panel2:rgba(20,20,35,.09);--border:rgba(20,20,35,.13);--card:rgba(255,255,255,.74);--navbg:rgba(246,246,242,.72);--vign:rgba(50,50,90,.1);--shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(40,40,80,.14);--hudbg:rgba(255,255,255,.75);--hudfg:#45454f;--hudbd:rgba(20,20,35,.12)}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;min-height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:#0c0c10;color:#ececf0;font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui}
:root[data-theme=light],:root[data-theme=light] body{background:#f6f6f2;color:#17171c}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{min-height:100vh;font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;transition:background-color .35s ease,color .35s ease}
body::after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;background:radial-gradient(130% 100% at 50% -10%,transparent 45%,var(--vign) 100%)}
#bg{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
#root{position:relative;z-index:1}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid rgb(var(--accent));outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}
::selection{background:rgba(var(--accent),.45)}
.grad{background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgb(var(--accent)),rgb(var(--accent2)),rgb(var(--accent)));background-size:220% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transpare
